Del Prado Collection Mineral Specimens - Set of 4
Ediciones del Prado, 23MNR Series
Factory Sealed in Original Blister Packs
This set of four mineral and rock specimens was released as part of the educational geology partwork series by Ediciones del Prado. Del Prado provided authentic worldwide mineral examples housed in molded blister packs for hobbyists and educational display. These vintage pieces showcase diverse geologic specimens, from polished stones to crystalline formations.
Four distinct mineral specimens individually mounted on foam display inserts
Includes reference markings Ref: 23MNR000000013 and Ref: 23MNR000000005
Variety includes polished green and red stones, metallic cuboid formation, and rough white mineral
Each blister base card bears the official "delPrado collection" imprint
Condition:
All four specimens remain factory sealed in original blister packaging. Blister bubbles exhibit cosmetic storage wear including scuffs, edge crinkles, and age-related yellowing on one pack. Interior specimens are untouched and firmly seated.

Hand-Carved Wooden Figurine
Man Smoking Pipe Folk Art Sculpture
Carved Solid Wood, 28 Inches
This hand-carved wooden folk art sculpture depicts a standing bearded man wearing a wide-brimmed hat and rustic attire, smoking a pipe and carrying a curved horn. Rendered from solid wood, the piece features expressive facial carving, rhythmic gouge work, and contrasting dark-stained accents that highlight the organic grain and textures of the timber. Large-scale figurative carvings of this style reflect traditional vernacular woodworking traditions and make compelling additions to rustic, global, or folk art collections.
Hand-carved solid timber construction with chiseled gouge details
Depicts a standing elder figure with pipe, brimmed hat, and shoulder strap
Natural warm wood tone accented with black-stained detailing
Integrated round pedestal base carved from the same solid block
